name: Villavieja del Lozoya (Spain)
description: Red field with a green chevron reversed from the upper corners to the lower centre, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villavieja del Lozoya (a column above waves and a bend with the words AVE MARIA).
history: Municipal flag of Villavieja del Lozoya; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: inverted chevron from the upper corners meeting at the lower centre
